Each chooses to give the entire 800 yen to the organizer or retain all of it. A donated 800 yen is doubled to 1600 yen and divided equally ONLY between the other two people: each gets 800 yen; the donor receives none of their own donation. Your scenario payoff is 800 yen for each other person who contributes, plus your own 800 yen if you retain it. This first scenario has no sanctions and gives no feedback about other players’ choices. The study records scenario responses; actual monetary payment is not documented. Predict the current all-or-none choice. Output only COOPERATE for giving 800 yen or DEFECT for keeping it.
